explication: Square is an Android music client for Spotify Premium and YouTube Music. A listener chooses a source, browses or searches its catalogue, and plays music through the app’s shared player; the README documents library management, lyrics, effects, video, and offline playback as additional capabilities. The graph groups those product stages and the main internal playback layer. Some source-specific wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so documented capability links use the README; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
